notes.title: 2022 Update - All I Want For Christmas Is Infinite Lives
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39309977/8d42ab2008f57cd184a05b18171012c44b11661b.png

Difficulty Slider
Attention, stealthy Santas! Are you tired of starting each level of Ho-Ho-Home Invasion over and over again when you get caught by the training robots? Well, your Christmas wish has been granted - we've added a lives system so you can keep on playing even if you get caught!

Introducing the newest update to Ho-Ho-Home Invasion - "All I Want for Christmas is Infinite Lives".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39309977/08f55213f9ce847fb81dbc00c8be4818fa6f4a7e.gif

ALL I WANT FOR CHRISTMAS IS INFINITE LIVESWith this update, you can choose the number of lives you have per level, allowing you to adjust the difficulty to your liking. And the best part? You can slide the difficulty all the way to Elf mode, which gives you an unlimited number of lives. It's the gift that keeps on giving (literally)!

Watch out for the time penalty though, you'll have 60 seconds added to your total time whenever you get caught. Access this slider for each level from the 'Levels' button on the main menu.

And don't worry, you can still play as sneak-a-claus intended with the original one chance per level. With seven different house layouts, you'll still need to be a real tinsel toes to avoid the training robots to deliver presents and escape safely.

LET'S DECK THE LEADERBOARDS!
And don't forget, we added leaderboards last year so you can compete against other stealthy Santas from around the world. Plus, with support for the latest version of the Tilt Five™ drivers (1.2.2), you can enjoy an even more immersive Ho-Ho-Home Invasion experience.

Download the newest update to Ho-Ho-Home Invasion now, and if you're feeling extra generous, you can support the developers with the "pay-what-you-like" model on Steam or by entering a purchase amount on itch.io.

As always, we encourage you to share your clips, streams, and videos with us on Twitter at @whitepot, or drop in to our community Discord server (discord.gg/whitepot) to say hi and share your scores on the leaderboards.

Happy holidays and happy playing!
Whitepot Studios.

P.S. Santa is now quadruple vaxxed

notes.title: That tasty "day one patch" feeling
notes.notes:
First thing’s first - thank you SO much to everyone who has played! We are completely blown away by the response - and making it to top of Stealth’s New & Trending 🎉 The best thing you can do to help us out is leave a review - it really helps boost visibility :D Thanks to everyone who has so far!

https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/T2KqBK0BM9HpQDBY4QQLl_QlCyMTre3cYDDADoDVtK56rh_WZtqSteWKN7FAPJ5C0h14IaKhEFktPSs9oHVaUrUpbHdTTn_4hsU2yOnLSs5QmvEUTW9O7ZbslYDU_i5-dlwGt1kO

Now, here’s the not-quite-day-one-patch update I’m sure you’ve all been waiting for.


 Localization
 "The Watcher 3"
 "The Master a-Chieve-ment Collection"
 "The Re-Binding of Isaac"
 Mouse Cursor Options
 Misc


[hr][/hr]

Localization
We’ve had so many requests for localization on top of this, so we’ve created a crowd-sourced page on Localizor for the community to add their translations. You can check that out here: https://www.localizor.com/ho-ho-home-invasion 

Hoping to have the first localizations up over this weekend! We’re over halfway through localizations for the following:
Portuguese (BR), French, German, Italian.
And looking for help starting the following languages:
Russian, Japanese. Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional, Dutch, Spanish, and Portuguese (PT).

https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/yYDkqIQuAS7iRweu3qWK4RGvbWegdqx4oyDNoRRB1xm5Mt0z9aICkClXN8SThf0rWYgDLv1GTVttlmq5OsxmGV1BGX4mF54kqs9267O5v49_ptDV-_VLyiCJzOsng-0m_gc76d-c

Thank you so much to the following awesome people who have contributed translations so far:
Thitz - https://steamcommunity.com/id/thitz/ camillesaraiva - https://localizor.com/user/8973  AlexisBarroso - https://steamcommunity.com/id/alexisbrso/ LisaBellu - https://www.localizor.com/user/8977/ 

[hr][/hr]

"The Watcher 3"
We moved the Watcher on Level 3 to make him react better to being lured out by whistling. If you’d like to see what happened instead, prior to this update, you can watch Droogie4Ever descending into misery.

https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/sljlGSKoJU-A3SveCJKSbQUlQCAcGZRViPBYUX4kaTNEQevVZgChCTzbxBsPgYM9Y9gA1Ao3Bip1I8eJpMovdEWX5oR2wF2DCmHJTSYhlM5sb2T_oVeJRuzowMxsWR6F5U6ZfVjQ

[hr][/hr]

"The Master a-Chieve-ment Collection"
There were some hiccups with the ‘Present Collection’ achievement unlocking, which have now been fixed. If you’ve met the requirements, these achievements should unlock upon opening the game if you haven’t played since this update. 

https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/DS5qlez12JxBhEB2nqBQniKAWeH6rL5_h2UfA1j7W6uXhCe5jGCTUAUHs3gS4m6OWvsh5bpBPb1FVzikTzfaozPK-7tNd6y8haoB4Nh3wzvEYYlU0PzfYmJKNq4AgrfJj5LBzs73

Congrats to Fellyjish for being the first to 100% Ho-Ho-Home Invasion! Truly, you are the ‘Master Achievement’.

[hr][/hr]

Accessibility
"The Re-Binding of Isaac"

https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/lE0-BKKVZgL1F7r1Cvn5Jlu4cUXj4mgMDQWcszGQL2mhxXisLRQBfFKXV84Zx5fdXdFZels2t6I6b0vQoDGHkI8JXt0Vq9IvbeIY_6K5epMaXqOwkvh7DL0Lxk4fnmcSJyytFt5d

To my dear AZERTY keyboard layout friends - we have now added a keyboard binding screen so you can rebind from WASD to QSZD, and never feel like this ever again. You can access this from the ‘Controls’ menu by selecting ‘Rebind’ at the bottom right.

https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/OlicpKNzE6hRnm2SXXtbQFWcDXw4MDWuhCUV56fWdxIAN83SNj409fnPus0HkmJjwqcsYXNfY1rxodJaCbDgoeM_r_TWN-1PIQJQl1T9LsvN2fIU2zmoo8Mdf20Qxj_CWr85CjTn

https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/ShRm8qXUmgIjbMyfmroZfLRwu9kw5qwR96KnkVIceKI4g2qsmRHX-_DYEZqzHtUeEpyuEIqqcjJ6nwSlii5zop7D0x832pY5oTsKUIIU8fQNMZJ_RQeqWAHvCuFGEu1Wn3BTvNN7

Mouse Cursor Options
The options menu now ~scrolls~ so we could fit more in there. You can scroll to the bottom of the options menu to change the following accessibility options.


Don’t Lock Mouse Cursor - allows it to move from the centre of the screen when playing
Don’t Constrain Mouse Cursor to Game Window - allows the mouse cursor to leave the game window when your mouse reaches the edges of it
Don’t Hide the Mouse Cursor - allows the mouse cursor to be shown at all times.

https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/TXviiSPQREvL-BYrHkUZcMpZHS3u2A5hHvJZVJ_wjLzWsDx6fgxTIgSAs6z42ksHVAulGUQzHfdC7_m3Pgd98_68E10YjFYkTmamYqfM0TBQPsZm5qJFk2aNkdxSLTuZaAl5qz2Y

Please let us know what further accessibility adjustments would be useful and we’ll try our best to make them. You can post in the Discussions forum or e-mail hello@whitepotstudios.com.
[hr][/hr]
Misc.

Anti-aliasing has been fixed!
‘Thier’ changed to ‘Their’ in the tutorial 😳


[hr][/hr]

Stay sneaky, Santas!
Vicky
